explanation: The English article on the war of 2008–2009 opens its background with the intifada’s end: on 8 February 2005 Mahmoud Abbas and Ariel Sharon signed a ceasefire agreement to bring an end to the Second Intifada, and on 17 March the thirteen main Palestinian factions agreed to it conditional on a cessation of Israeli attacks; Israel completed its unilateral disengagement from Gaza in September 2005. The article then dates the breakdown of that ceasefire to June 2006.
